image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a baked meatloaf in a dark baking pan. The loaf is oblong with a domed top, covered in a glossy, reddish-brown glaze that appears caramelized and slightly sticky. The surface texture shows the granularity of ground meat beneath the glaze, with some darker browned areas along the ridges. The edges of the loaf meet the pan, showing some rendered fat or juices pooling at the bottom left.
